high_level_description: This image is a striking photograph titled "Contrasts" by Marco Di Marco, featured as part of Fine Art Photography – Photojournalism. The scene captures the dramatic interaction between natural forces and human infrastructure. Setting: The photograph is set on the Reykjanes Peninsula in Iceland during the third eruptive episode of the 2023–2024 Svartsengi volcanic system. The landscape is a stark contrast of natural elements: molten lava, snow, and volcanic ash. Objects: Lava: A bright orange and red
